title: A Rainbow Round the Light
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Far from his home, down by the stream,
Ezekiel stood near;
Then all at once the sky swung wide
And heaven's light shone clear.

[Chorus]
Oh, stop and look, oh, stop and see,
The sky is open wide!
A rainbow round the throne of light,
And the Lord is at your side.

[Verse 2]
He saw a throne, a king's own chair,
And Someone shining there;
The brightness glowed like fire and gold
And filled the morning air.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Around the light a rainbow bent
Like colors after rain;
He did not rush, he knelt down low,
And looked and looked again.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
When rain has passed and colors bend
Across a sky washed new,
Stand still and whisper, "Thank You, Lord,"
For He is near to you.

[Chorus]
mood: Looking-up music. A slow, open sway under the voice, like a child standing still at a window while the colors come out after rain. A small celtic harp picking out the shape of the arc, one cello note held long and warm underneath, nothing hurried. Quiet with wonder rather than sad, and it opens a little wider with each verse until the last line rests inside the light.
